description: Query the NF registry for modules whose id or name contains query. Use it to resolve a module ID before module_read; do not use it for the authoritative protocol package catalog (spec_list) or free-text document search (library_search). Matching is case-sensitive; query is required, and an empty query matches every entry (examples: M90, 技术文档域包). Results are grouped under modules and protocols, with protocol hits secondary. Reads registry.json only and never scans module or pipeline files; it never matches descriptions, paths, or file contents, and no matches yields empty arrays.

query.description: Case-sensitive substring matched against module and protocol ids and names.

name: registry_search

outputSchema.description: Modules and protocol packages matching query.

protocols.description: Matching protocol packages in registry order.

id.description: Protocol package ID accepted by spec_list.

modules.description: Number of module IDs bound to the package.

title: Search module registry
